scope: Field Collector sync handler with PostgreSQL consent withdrawal and regrant
method: Created a disposable restored clone of the candidate database, inserted synthetic location, person, reviewed required-consent form revision, participant link, device token hash, and grant/withdraw/regrant events, then called the real sync handler with the temporary database selected via PG_DB.
scenario: A valid grant existed at collection time; withdrawal took effect after collection; a later grant was current when sync ran.

result.detail: Consent was withdrawn or denied after collection

limitations: The handler function was invoked directly with a real PostgreSQL connection; this did not traverse the Gateway ASGI/HTTP stack or the browser UI.
The candidate database was not modified; the temporary clone and dump were removed after the check.
rollback: All synthetic rows were confined to the disposable database, which was dropped after the run.
